observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor room with tiled floor, likely a party or celebration
observation.posture: upright torso, knees slightly bent, weight shifts between feet
observation.footwork: rhythmic stepping, including side-steps, kicks, and hops, generally on the beat
observation.arms_and_hands: arms held at shoulder height or raised, hands joined in a line
observation.partnering: dancers hold hands in a line
observation.levels_jumps_turns: dancers perform jumps, kicks, and occasional synchronized drops to one knee
observation.cannot_infer: exact footwork details due to low resolution and camera angle

signature_moments.what: synchronized deep knee bends while in a line
